note: Set A is clean but narrow and heavily redundant: its 12 claims reduce to about six unique facts (display sizes, brightness, guest count, simultaneous operation), all correctly bound but with each size repeated in inch and cm form, and it omits most of the page's content (safety rules, alcohol, water, cookware, meal location, outdoor cooking). Set B covers that missing material with mostly correct claims (alcohol prohibitions, sealed drinking water, cookware washing, non-decathlete restriction, outdoor grilling, hors d'oeuvres location) and only a few defects: a garbled 'brightness | maximum' claim, a wrong 'during cooking' condition on the flame ban (source says during contest week), a truncated/garbled meal-location value, and a mangled 'according to size' quote. Given that missing important facts count against a set, B's broader correct coverage outweighs its handful of errors.
